newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan King orders giving jobs to graduates.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan King orders giving jobs to graduates.

text.p: King Hassan has ordered his interior minister to recruit 70 jobless graduates who were staging a series of hunger strikes in Rabat, the official MAP news agency said on Saturday.
King Hassan ordered Interior Minister Driss Basri to visit the hunger strikers and assure them of the government's desire to help them.
"Following King Hassan's instructions, the government will take immediate measures to recruit the 70 Ph.D jobless," MAP quoted Basri as saying.
Morocco has an estimated 300,000 unemployed university graduates, trade unions say. Urban unemployment is officially estimated at 18.5 percent of the workforce.
